description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Regulation of allowances to the MC,, Regulation of allowances to the UC,. Regulation of allowances to the  PS.
categorisation: This gazette establishes regulations for various allowances (travel, subsistence, accommodation, telephone, sitting allowances) for municipal council officials (Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Councilors) and their staff. It pertains to public service conditions, benefits, and administrative instructions for local government officials, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than central government structure/personnel changes.
